description: This file defines the 'Comment' controller class within the OpenCart admin panel for managing CMS comments. It includes methods for listing comments, approving comments, marking comments as spam, and deleting comments, with operations involving filtering, pagination, and permission checks.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS comments in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, approving, marking spam, and deleting comments.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of comments with filtering options and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the retrieval and output of the comments list, applying filters and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view of the comments list based on filters and pagination.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves selected comments, setting their status to approved.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Marks selected comments as spam, updates their status, possibly deletes customer comments, and responds with a JSON success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected comments, handles permission validation, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Refreshes comment ratings, calculates like/dislike totals, updates ratings and comment counts, and handles permission checking, returning a JSON response.
